description: Check up to 100 email addresses in one call: shape, MX records read live, disposable domains and role accounts, with a verdict per address. Domain deliverability, not a mailbox probe. $0.009 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: email_verify
